svg.title: FreightLens system architecture
svg.desc: ECC guides development and audit, outside the runtime. A local FastAPI application extracts and validates document text, records evidence in SQLite, and requires employee approval before JSON export. Findings or outdated policy block approval and export. A small Gemini public-PDF evaluation is recorded; Kimi is not live verified.
svg.text: A clear path from paperwork to approval.
Local portfolio prototype · One modular Python application · Human decisions
Upload boundary, data handling, approval gates
Development guidance and review roles only. ECC is not a runtime dependency or an in-app agent team.
Browser + single FastAPI modular application + SQLite
Bound file size, pages, text length
Cited quote must exist on the page
Stored provenance: provider · model · pipeline · extraction · rules revision
when a hosted mode is selected.
No silent fallback to demo mode.
No API key in code or diagrams
Not part of the current runtime.
AI extracts. Python validates. Employees approve.
No automatic emails or payments. No RAG, memory, autonomous agents, model tools or webhooks.
FreightLens · Current local prototype architecture · PNG + editable SVG + Mermaid source
